notes.title: kitchen Wars available now!
notes.content:
🍳 Kitchen Wars is Out Now on Steam! 🍔

The wait is over, chefs! After the chaos, laughter, and delicious mayhem of the Appetizer Version, the full version of Kitchen Wars is finally LIVE on Steam!

💥 Run your chaotic restaurant
🥊 Brawl with other chefs
🧄 Steal, sabotage, and survive the madness

Whether you're in it to serve the best dishes or just ruin your friend's kitchen, the full experience is here—packed with new features, more maps, unlockables, and extra spicy party-game fun!

🟢 Play now: Kitchen Wars on Steam

👨‍🍳 Don't forget to:

Follow our Steam page to stay updated on patches, events, and new content!

Join the official Discord to find matches, report bugs, share memes, and talk with the devs and community: Join Discord

See you in the kitchen... if you can survive it. 🔪🔥

— The Kitchen Wars Team


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2955840/Kitchen_Wars/

We’ve got spicy news straight from the kitchen…

🔥 Kitchen Wars officially launches on Steam on April 16th! 🔥
Grab your spatulas and sharpen your knives—this is not your average dinner service.

🍔fight, steal & serve
🎉 Pure chaotic fun with friends (or foes!)

Whether you're sabotaging rival restaurants, stealing their chairs, or trying to deliver a burger while on fire, Kitchen Wars turns up the heat in every round.

Already tried the free demo, Kitchen Wars: Appetiser?
Then you know the madness that's about to unfold.
If not—what are you waiting for? Warm up those reflexes and get a taste of the action!

🗓️ Add Kitchen Wars to your Wishlist

notes.title: Kitchen Wars: Appetiser Release Announcement
notes.content:
🎉 Kitchen Wars: Appetiser is Now Available for FREE! 🎉  

We’re thrilled to announce that Kitchen Wars: Appetiser is now available for FREE on Steam! Dive into the chaotic fun of culinary combat and experience the madness with your friends.

We’d love to hear your thoughts! Join our Discord Server to share your feedback, report any bugs, or just hang out with the community and the dev team. Your feedback is incredibly important to us as we work to make the game even better!

🔗 Discord Server

We’re here to help and listen, so don’t hesitate to reach out. Let’s make Kitchen Wars: Appetiser even better together!

Thank you for your support, and we can’t wait to see you in the kitchen!
